reviews.title: Fitbit App
reviews.text:
I paid $50 for the use of the Fitbit app.   It was to use my Fitbit that I’ve been wearing for years.  I paid a good amount for the Fitbit and now it’s almost useless.   I’m not able to sync it to answer my phone, check my sleep, and numerous other things.   I don’t think it’s worth ever buying another Fitbit.   I’ve been using the Fitbit for 9 years.  Since Google took over, I have no use for it.   Any watch can tell me the time and date 
Sincerely 
Vikki Leedy
